method: Dataset card, data_distribution.md and the Hugging Face dataset-server size and rows endpoints (one row read). Metadata only; no patches or trajectories committed. Per-row instance IDs were not downloaded (the parquet shards are 263 GB-scale), so cross-configuration task overlap is unmeasured.
purpose: Training traces for distilling SWE agents, not a benchmark submission.
tasks: SWE-rebench-V2 and Scale-SWE training instances, many repositories. Languages by trajectories (v1.2): Python 157,692, Go 32,249, TypeScript 24,112, JavaScript 19,521, Rust 14,440, Java 7,926, PHP 6,726, C/C++ 705.
row_fields: instance_id, repo, license, language, trajectory_id, messages, tools, resolved (1/0/-1), metadata {category, teacher_model, reference_patch, model_patch {patch, num_modified_files, num_modified_lines}}, hf_dataset_name. No base commit: preimage identity must come from the source datasets by instance_id.
verified: One v1.2 mini-SWE-agent row (Scale-SWE python-distro_distro_pr145) has a nonempty unified-diff model_patch and resolved = 1. Split row counts match the documented totals.
blockers: No predefined evaluation population: each configuration covers a different, undocumented subset of training tasks (10,511 to 41,405 unique tasks), and v1.0 had trajectories with git-hacking behaviour removed after release. Released rows are a curated training set, so Solved % is not a benchmark rate.
Same-task ranking needs tasks shared by at least 4 configurations; overlap is unmeasured and would need the instance_id column of every shard.
Before-state identity: rows carry no base commit; it would have to be joined from SWE-rebench-V2 / Scale-SWE and corroborated per touched file across thousands of repositories.
Models are small or mid-size open models (Qwen 27B/Flash, Qwen3.5-122B, MiniMax-M2.5, DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731), several harnesses; none are on an existing board's population.
verdict: Not usable for an existing board and not releasable as a new board under the acceptance checklist (no frozen population). Skip unless the owner wants a separate, clearly labelled training-trace board; then first download only the instance_id/resolved columns to measure overlap.
